title: URL category API behavior beyond the field list: delete, lookup and the keyword quota figure

prose.text: The API guide for URL categories holds a few behaviors beyond the field list. The entry syntax and quotas of the console are in [[zia.url-categories.entry-format]], and the lookup's relation to cloud applications in [[zia.cloud-app-control.rule-criteria]].

prose.label: Write shape.
prose.text: What the API does with echoed server-assigned fields is open {{gap:server-fields-on-write}}.

checks.do: Whether a delete failed because the category is still referenced by a URL policy or NSS feed.
Which keyword quota figure applies: the Ranges and Limitations table, not the older 30 and 1,000 in the API guide.
Whether a lookup batch stays within 100 URLs of at most 1,024 characters, and that custom classifications never appear in the answer.

delete-blocked-when-referenced.statement: Predefined URL categories cannot be deleted, and deleting a custom category that a URL policy or NSS feed uses fails.

quotes: You can delete custom URL and TLD categories, but predefined URL categories cannot be deleted.
the custom category you are trying to delete is being used by a URL policy or NSS feed, the request fails.

urllookup-limits.statement: POST /urlLookup takes up to 100 URLs per request and each URL may be at most 1,024 characters.

quotes: You can look up to 100 URLs maximum per request, and a URL cannot exceed 1024 characters.

urllookup-security-alert.statement: The /urlLookup response carries a SecurityAlert field whose values include, but are not limited to, a published list such as PHISHING, BOTNET, MALWARE_SITE and PAGE_RISK_INDEX.

quotes: The /urlLookup endpoint returns a field called SecurityAlert whose possible values include, but
are not limited to, the following:

urllookup-custom-omitted.statement: Custom URL classification is not returned by a lookup, and URLs not in a predefined category come back as MISCELLANEOUS_OR_UNKNOWN.

quotes: Custom URL classification is not returned by this request.

keyword-quota-ranges.statement: The Ranges and Limitations article allows 256 custom keywords per category, with a maximum of 2,048 across all categories.

quotes: | Custom Keywords per Category | 256 keywords | There can be a maximum of 2,048 custom keywords across all categories. |

keyword-quota-pdf.statement: The URL Categories API guide says up to 30 keywords per category and up to 1,000 across all categories.

quotes: can add up to 30 keywords per category, and up to 1,000 across all categories.

server-fields-on-write.title: What the API does with server-assigned category fields sent on update
server-fields-on-write.detail: Unverified legacy statement: The category model carries val, editable, customCategory and urlKeywordCounts, and the earlier reference said the SDK echoes them on PUT while the API ignores them on write; no vendored source states how the API treats them when sent.
server-fields-on-write.blocks: Whether a read-modify-write of a category can send these fields back safely.

keyword-quota-figures.summary: The URL Categories API guide and the Ranges and Limitations article give different keyword quotas.

positions.says: Up to 30 keywords per category and up to 1,000 across all categories.

quotes: can add up to 30 keywords per category, and up to 1,000 across all categories.

positions.says: 256 keywords per category and a maximum of 2,048 across all categories.

quotes: | Custom Keywords per Category | 256 keywords | There can be a maximum of 2,048 custom keywords across all categories. |

keyword-quota-figures.impact: Planning keyword-heavy categories on the PDF figure under-counts the capacity the limits article gives; the limits article is the maintained table.
